title: What feature engineering actually taught us

segments.voiceover: We tested whether recent behavior helps predict leaving the Premium package. Each feature variant was retrained with the same learner settings and training rules, using five matched random seeds.
segments.takeaway: One feature package at a time. Five matched seeds.

segments.voiceover: We compared last-month values, monthly changes, three-month averages, balance and payroll relative to their own recent averages, and card utilization. Only relative funds passed our predeclared selection rule.
segments.takeaway: Only relative funds passed the first selection rule.

segments.voiceover: After tuning, that ensemble scored about four hundred and two on Inicial, below our earlier reference. We then tested six-month history, monetary ranks, usage changes, and an exponential moving average.
segments.takeaway: One published final recipe; then a separate history pilot.

segments.voiceover: We expected EMA to flag disengagement by emphasizing recent behavior. Six-month funds and three-month usage improved historical profit in both months. EMA’s profit benefit was inconsistent. These variants were never publicly scored.
segments.takeaway: Historical profit improved for some variants; none was public-scored.

segments.voiceover: Later engineered pipelines reached the Senior leaderboard. None beat our champion’s public score of about four hundred and fifty-four. That champion already includes extensive historical features.
segments.takeaway: The rich-history champion remains the public reference.

segments.voiceover: Our recommendation: keep the rich-history champion. Prioritize controlled retests of six-month funds history and three-month usage. Keep EMA exploratory, and distinguish historical improvements from measured public performance.
segments.takeaway: Keep the champion. Test funds6 and usage3 separately.

feature_selection_rule: Positive mean paired AUC change and improvement in at least 4 of 5 matched seeds

initial_public.attribution: Selected feature package plus tuned learner, full-history refit, ensemble and contact policy

ema.label: Prior-only EMA3
ema.hypothesis: Recent changes may signal emerging disengagement more clearly than equally weighted older behavior

pilot.metric: Mean paired historical profit delta per 100,000 customers versus funds3

senior_public.attribution: Matched contact count; complete recipes differ in representation, learner settings and seeds

recommendation.exploratory: Prior-only EMA3, decay 0.5; historical profit inconsistent across months
